briefings.title: CVE-2026-86060: MikroTik RouterOS actively exploited
briefings.excerpt: MikroTik RouterOS contains an improper neutralization of argument delimiters in a command vulnerability which allows an attacked to change the trusted RouterOS policy mask, leading to privilege escalation.

briefings.title: CVE-2026-67277: MikroTik RouterOS actively exploited
briefings.excerpt: MikroTik RouterOS contains a missing authenticaion for critical function vulnerability which allows kernel memory disclosure and denial of service in the btest service.

briefings.title: CVE-2026-19490: Citrix NetScaler actively exploited

briefings.title: CVE-2026-68487 — CRITICAL (CVSS 9.9)
briefings.excerpt: Path traversal in Plesk's Backup Manager causes arbitrary file write as root by an authenticated customer.

briefings.title: CVE-2026-68488 — CRITICAL (CVSS 9.9)
briefings.excerpt: A Time-of-check Time-of-use (TOCTOU) race condition leading to insecure symlink following in Plesk causes local privilege escalation to root via arbitrary file/directory ownership takeover.

briefings.title: CVE-2026-52098 — CRITICAL (CVSS 9.8)
briefings.excerpt: An issue in Flowise 3.1.2 allows a remote attacker to execute arbitrary code via the /api/v1/prediction/<flowId> endpoint
